title: Joseph W. Sitati
vital_facts: Baptized 1986; Aaronic Priesthood and Melchizedek Priesthood subsequently
Bachelor’s in Mechanical Engineering, University of Nairobi, 1975; Diploma in Accounting and Finance
Executive for “Reach the Children,” Executive for the Total Group; International Director of Public Affairs for the Church in Africa.
First Quorum of the Seventy 2009 - present
